title: 把演讲稿收起来  (Put the Speech Away)

segments.t: Five minutes before three at the front desk, Manager Zhou is straightening his tie and reading frantically from five sheets of paper in front of Qing and Chen. Let's listen in first.
“尊敬的市政代表，八十多年来，这座历史悠久的小院……”
老板，您要是像念税务课本一样说话，办事员站着都会睡着。
周经理，先深呼吸一下，把这五页纸都放进抽屉里吧。
放进抽屉里？！那人家走进大门的时候，我说什么呀？！
就说：“下午好，欢迎来到九号房，请坐下来喝杯热茶！”
让明亮的玻璃窗、小美的热面包和宋老师的钢琴替您说话。
你们真的觉得，简简单单地招待客人就够了吗？
周经理，热情好客正是这栋老房子八十多年来最拿手的事呀。
等等——我的老花镜现在是不是又架在额头上？
安安全全装在您西装口袋里呢，老板。领带很正，皮鞋也干净。
快听——院子门口的铜铃响了！三点整，一分不差！
深呼吸……微笑……我们出去迎接客人吧！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
“尊敬的市政代表，八十多年来，这座历史悠久的小院……”

'"Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard..."' Manager Zhou goes full ceremonial banquet style! Opening with "esteemed" belongs on formal podiums, making his nervous rehearsal instant comedy.
老板，您要是像念税务课本一样说话，办事员站着都会睡着。

'Boss, if you talk like you're reading a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.' Even while roasting his boss, Chen keeps the polite form of "you". And "textbook" straightforwardly combines "lesson" and "book".
周经理，先深呼吸一下，把这五页纸都放进抽屉里吧。
'Take one deep breath first, Manager Zhou, and put all five pages into the drawer.' Look at the word for "breathe": "exhale-inhale" side by side, capturing both halves of a breath in two syllables.
放进抽屉里？！那人家走进大门的时候，我说什么呀？！

'Into the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the front gate?!' Zhou uses a very natural conversational word for "they/the guest", literally "other-household", heard constantly in everyday chat.
就说：“下午好，欢迎来到九号房，请坐下来喝杯热茶！”

'Just say: "Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for a cup of hot tea!"' Slipping that tiny word for "just" right before "say" makes Qing's suggestion sound effortless—no five-page script required.
让明亮的玻璃窗、小美的热面包和宋老师的钢琴替您说话。

'Let the bright glass windows, Mei's warm bread, and Teacher Song's piano do the talking for you.' Where English says "do the talking", Mandarin says "speak in your place", built around a crisp word meaning "on behalf of".
你们真的觉得，简简单单地招待客人就够了吗？
'Do you really think simple, warm hospitality is enough?' In Mandarin, doubling both halves of "simple"—"jian-jian-dan-dan"—turns plain "simple" into "nice and unpretentious".
周经理，热情好客正是这栋老房子八十多年来最拿手的事呀。

'Warm hospitality is the very thing this old house has done best for over eighty years, Manager Zhou.' Qing's lively word for "best at" literally means "good in the hand", originally praising a cook's signature dish!
等等——我的老花镜现在是不是又架在额头上？

'Wait—are my reading glasses perched on my forehead again right now?' Zhou's trademark blind spot returns! In Mandarin, reading glasses are called "old-blurry-vision mirrors", an affectionate everyday name.
安安全全装在您西装口袋里呢，老板。领带很正，皮鞋也干净。

'Tucked safely inside your suit pocket, boss. Tie straight, leather shoes clean.' "Suit" is literally "western-clothing", while "necktie" is "collar-ribbon" and "shoes" here specifies "leather-shoes".
快听——院子门口的铜铃响了！三点整，一分不差！
'Listen—the brass bell at the courtyard gate just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!' Qing caps the hour with a crisp four-word phrase—"one minute not off"—the spoken twin of "right on the dot".
深呼吸……微笑……我们出去迎接客人吧！
'Deep breath... smile... let's go out and welcome our guest!' Zhou picks a warm two-character word for greeting a visitor at the gate, built from "step out to meet" plus "receive".
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
“尊敬的市政代表，八十多年来，这座历史悠久的小院……”
老板，您要是像念税务课本一样说话，办事员站着都会睡着。
周经理，先深呼吸一下，把这五页纸都放进抽屉里吧。
放进抽屉里？！那人家走进大门的时候，我说什么呀？！
就说：“下午好，欢迎来到九号房，请坐下来喝杯热茶！”
让明亮的玻璃窗、小美的热面包和宋老师的钢琴替您说话。
你们真的觉得，简简单单地招待客人就够了吗？
周经理，热情好客正是这栋老房子八十多年来最拿手的事呀。
等等——我的老花镜现在是不是又架在额头上？
安安全全装在您西装口袋里呢，老板。领带很正，皮鞋也干净。
快听——院子门口的铜铃响了！三点整，一分不差！
深呼吸……微笑……我们出去迎接客人吧！
The stiff speech stays in the drawer, the gate bell rings at three sharp, and Manager Zhou steps out with a genuine smile. See you next time.
回头见！
